items.title: Change Data Capture (CDC)
items.description: Comprehensive guide on Change Data Capture (CDC), detailing how it works, alternatives comparison, implementation patterns with Debezium and Spring, and deep dives for senior engineers.

items.title: Chapters 30–32: The Database, Web & Frameworks Are Details

items.title: Comprehensive Java Interview Questions
items.description: Comprehensive Java and Spring interview set spanning core Java, collections, Hibernate, and Spring.

items.title: Cookies vs Sessions vs JWT

items.title: CQRS & Event Sourcing
items.description: Comprehensive guide on Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) and Event Sourcing, detailing architecture, implementation patterns, comparisons with alternatives, and deep dives for senior engineers.

items.title: Cryptography & Secure Design

items.title: Database Connection Pooling

items.description: Curated Spring Data JPA and Hibernate interview questions with concise, practical answers.
